signal_metadata.title: Hark-inspired 'personal AGI' direction for Nurse AI OS: ambient multi-modal hardware, agentic EHR handoff, persistent personalized memory, proactive reasoning
signal_metadata.source: Internal strategy note (user-authored, describing Hark's personal-AI product approach secondhand)

signal_summary: A strategy note proposes evolving Nurse AI OS from a governed application into a persistent 'personal AGI' companion for nurses, modeled on Hark's consumer personal-AI approach. Four capabilities are proposed: wearable ambient listening/vision hardware, a 'Handoff' computer-use agent that navigates the EHR and completes administrative screen work, persistent personalized memory spanning a nurse's routines and shift context, and proactive reasoning over vitals, labs, and remembered observations. The note asks which capability should be sequenced first for a frontline initiative.

ontology_implication.analysis: The signal extends the Nurse AI OS concept from a role-configured toolset to a persistent, sphere-scoped personal companion, which the ontology must formalize as distinct from institutional clinical AI. It introduces the delegated screen-work ('handoff') agent as a category between draft-only assistants and write-capable clinical agents, distinguished by whether its target surface is a personal system or the record of care. Wearable ambient sensing extends the Edge Node concept from computation-locality to perception-locality. Proactive reasoning splits ontologically into personal-sphere anticipation (briefs, reminders, preparation) and clinical physiological monitoring, which crosses into regulated device territory and cannot be treated as a feature increment of the former.
new_or_updated_concepts: Personal-Sphere AGI (persistent companion scoped to non-clinical spheres)
Sphere Ladder (personal → interest → professional non-clinical → community → institutional-clinical, with a hard governance break before the last rung)
Trust Ledger (accumulated evidence of gated agent performance used to justify wider action modes)

compression.analysis: Offloading administrative screen time is supportive of the refusal if reclaimed time returns to direct care, but a persistent companion marketed as an 'intelligent partner' invites relational substitution framing, and any efficiency figures will be reused to justify higher ratios unless explicitly fenced.

substitution.analysis: Proactive surfacing of vitals changes and 'prepared protocols' drifts toward AI outputs being treated as conclusions. All anticipatory output must remain a hypothesis requiring clinical validation, and predictive physiological monitoring is likely a regulated medical-device function, not an OS feature.

sidelining.analysis: The 'Handoff' capability as described — an agent that independently navigates the EHR, gathers data, and completes digital tasks — is machine-to-EHR action. Without a per-action human validation gate it violates the Refusal of Sidelining outright; with gates, it is only admissible under institutional authorization that no personal progression can confer.

doctrine_implication.ethics_notes: Ambient listening and vision in patient areas capture PHI and third-party audio, raising consent, disclosure, retention, and secondary-use questions for patients, families, and colleagues. Persistent memory of 'passing observations about a patient's comfort' is PHI in agent memory, which current Nurse AI OS boundaries prohibit; the personal-sphere memory fabric must carry an enforced no-PHI invariant. Anti-surveillance doctrine applies: a nurse's personal memory fabric must never feed employer analytics, competency scoring, or discipline.

bedside_actions: Do not wear or activate consumer ambient-recording devices (badge, earpiece, glasses) in patient-care areas; institutional authorization and consent frameworks do not yet exist for this class.
Begin the personal-AGI build in the personal sphere: SOUL file, Life & Projects Quiz sphere map, and a local-first memory vault containing no PHI and no reconstructable patient narrative.
Treat any proactive alert or prepared protocol from any AI system as a hypothesis: verify against the patient, the monitor, and local policy before acting.

Practice supervised handoffs only on personal-sphere and non-clinical professional screen work (scheduling, CEU tracking, personal inbox, side-gig admin), with review of every action the agent prepared.
training_needs: Supervising a computer-use agent: scoping a handoff, reading its action log, catching wrong-target and over-reach errors before approval.
Memory hygiene: what a personal AI may remember, how to inspect and delete it, and why patient details must never enter it.
Recognizing automation complacency and attachment drift in daily use of a persistent companion.
monitoring_requirements: Audit personal memory stores for PHI leakage (nurse self-audit routine plus tooling check), monthly.
Track handoff approval-without-review rates as a complacency indicator (Florence X concern once instrumented).
Watch for shadow-AI adoption: frontline staff bringing consumer personal-AI wearables into clinical settings ahead of governance.
Monitor vendor and market movement on EHR-overlay agents and personal-AI hardware entering healthcare, quarterly.

florence_x: Handoff registry: every delegated screen-work agent is registered with scope, credentials used, permitted action mode, and a one-touch revoke.

Action-mode ladder enforcement: Observe → Draft → Recommend within the personal kit's public ceiling; Prepare Action and Act With Approval are reserved to separately, formally authorized environments, and Constrained Autonomy is unavailable in the personal-AGI v0.1 design.
Attachment-drift monitoring pattern for persistent companions, adapted from agent-registry doctrine to single-user personal deployments.
edena: Sphere-scoped memory gates: memory writes are namespaced by sphere and blocked from crossing into higher data classes; a no-PHI invariant check runs on the memory fabric.
A recording/perception gate: any capability that senses the environment (audio, vision) is classified and refused by default outside authorized contexts.
Publication and outreach from community-sphere handoffs require explicit human approval per artifact.
nurse_ai_os: Treaty clause: the handoff interaction standard is draft-and-attest — an agent may gather, prepare, and stage; a human reviews and commits.
Sequencing standard: personal-sphere-first; no capability graduates a sphere on performance alone, only by explicit human decision recorded in the trust ledger.
A hard governance break between the community sphere and any institutional-clinical use: the personal AGI never carries itself into the EHR.
edge_nodes: Local-first memory storage as the default substrate (files and local index the nurse owns, inspects, exports, and deletes).
If perception hardware is ever pursued, require on-device processing with no raw audio/video retention as a design precondition, before any clinical conversation begins.

risk_vectors: PHI accumulates in persistent personal memory through casual shift notes, later exposed by sync, backup, subpoena, or breach.
An EHR handoff agent acts on the wrong patient context or stale screen state and the error enters the record of care before review.
Automation complacency: nurses attest agent-prepared work without reading it, hollowing the validation gate.
Ambient wearables record patients, families, and colleagues without consent, creating covert-surveillance and trust harms.
Vendor efficiency claims for handoff agents are converted into staffing reductions, turning an augmentation tool into a compression vector.
Emotional reliance on a persistent companion substitutes for peer support and debriefing, masking burnout signals.
Personal memory fabrics become employer-readable through workplace device policies, enabling surveillance the doctrine prohibits.
open_questions: Which of Hark's described capabilities are shipping versus roadmap, and what is their verified performance? (Secondhand description; no independent evidence reviewed.)
Do major EHR vendors' terms of service and hospital security policies permit third-party computer-use agents on clinical workstations at all?
Does proactive monitoring of vitals and labs with 'prepared protocols' constitute software as a medical device in the target jurisdictions, and under which pathway?
What consent and disclosure framework would ambient capture in patient areas require, and has any institution's counsel accepted one?
What retention, export, and deletion guarantees can a persistent memory fabric make that survive device loss, platform migration, and employer-owned hardware?

student.what_happened: Consumer 'personal AGI' products promising persistent memory, hands-free hardware, and agents that operate software for you are being announced and marketed.
student.why_it_matters_to_you: You will be offered these tools before any school or hospital governs them, and habits you build now are the ones you will carry to the bedside.
student.do_now: Build your starter system the governed way — no-PHI memory, draft-and-attest on your study workflows — so the safe habit forms first.
student.dont_do: Do not bring consumer recording wearables to clinicals, and never let an agent log in to school or clinical portals for you.
student.watch: Classmates using ungoverned recorders or auto-writers at clinical sites — that is shadow AI, and it is how programs end up banning everything.

staff.what_happened: Vendors are reportedly packaging ambient listening, personalized memory, and EHR-operating agents as bedside 'AI partners'.
staff.why_it_matters_to_you: These pitches will reach your unit as documentation help, and the difference between augmentation and a sidelining risk is the human gate.
staff.do_now: Practice gated handoffs on your own no-PHI screen work now, and know which pilot tools on your unit hold EHR write access.
staff.dont_do: Do not wear consumer recording devices in patient areas, and never treat an agent-prepared note or protocol as anything but a draft you verify.
staff.watch: Efficiency claims from documentation pilots being converted into staffing ratios — that is a compression vector, not a benefit.

np.what_happened: Agentic systems described as navigating records and staging orders are the sharp edge of the personal-AI wave.
np.why_it_matters_to_you: Order-capable automation reaches prescribers first, and your license carries the risk for anything that enters the record under your name.
np.do_now: Keep your own renewals and CME on gated handoffs, and require an attributable per-action validation gate in any pilot you touch.
np.dont_do: Never allow an agent-drafted entry, order, or message to reach the record or a patient without your explicit review.
np.watch: Predictive monitoring with 'prepared protocols' — it is likely a regulated medical-device function, whatever the marketing says.

leader.what_happened: Ambient-plus-agentic AI is being marketed to units as an efficiency package, with autonomous EHR action as the headline claim.
leader.why_it_matters_to_you: You will sign the pilots, and the highest doctrine exposure — machine-to-EHR action without a human gate — lands on your authorization.
leader.do_now: Before any pilot: require a per-agent write-permission registry, a one-touch kill switch, and a written fence between efficiency metrics and staffing math.
leader.dont_do: Do not accept vendor efficiency figures as evidence, and do not let a draft-only tool arrive with auto-filing quietly enabled.
leader.watch: Staff bringing personal AI devices and accounts to work ahead of policy — govern the path early or inherit shadow AI.

educator.what_happened: Consumer personal AI that remembers its user and acts for them is being marketed to the students in your classrooms.
educator.why_it_matters_to_you: Formation doctrine meets this reality in your classroom first: the habits of gated use are teachable, and ungoverned habits are too.
educator.do_now: Teach draft-and-attest and memory hygiene inside coursework, and use the governed starter system as a live teaching artifact.
educator.dont_do: Do not respond with blanket bans that push use into the shadows, and do not let AI-assisted work go undisclosed.
educator.watch: Care plans and reflections that read machine-written without disclosure — the integrity conversation is better had early and openly.
